offer.text: They're testing the gate again tonight. Plant yourself at the wall with me and cut down eight of them before they break through — hold this ground.

accept.text: Then hold the gate. Not one of them gets past.

decline.text: Then I hold it alone, and pray the bar holds too.

in_progress.text: Hold the line! How many at the gate have you dropped?

ready.text: Eight down and the gate still ours. Well held, watcher.

complete.text: The gate stood the night because you stood at it. The village owes you a quiet dawn.

failed.text: They breached before we cleared them. A hard night — and a harder morning.
